## What these figures mean

As for vols. 1–3 and 6: see `ocr/03/articles-report.md` for how articles are located, and
`ocr/06/articles-report.md` for `folded`. Every row is `status: "ocr"`. Nothing is proofread.

## Vol. 9 specifics

- **772 pages carry index entries**, 6,805 index headwords, 6,652 distinct. Located 92.5%, label +
  body 86.0%. No page is bound out of order and the misfiled-headword test finds nothing.
- **Against the typed witness** (`docs/witness-join.md`): it has 6,646 of the 6,652 distinct
  headwords (99.9%). Labels agree on 98.6% of the 5,850 rows where both have one; analyses are
  ≥ 0.8 similar in 90.0%, < 0.4 in 0.5%.
- **The print sets the anusvāra of ိံ apart** (တာဝတိ˙သ…, pp. 421–423; တိံသ…, pp. 436–437), and the
  OCR reads it as a space or drops it. Recall misses these headwords; the fuzzy alignment, which
  ignores ံ, places most of them (p. 422: 9 of 11, all right).
- **P. 823 was misread on the Mac**: both passes came out as fragments (1 and 3 of 12 headwords),
  on a clean page. The same code on the same page in the cloud container read 11 of 12. The cause
  is not known; it is the only such page found in this volume (the other pages under 30% are
  glyph problems and read no better a second time). Re-read it natively before the next re-run of
  this book's articles.
- **More labels left unnormalised** than in recent volumes (180, 2.6%), mostly sense numbers and
  fragments of headwords read as labels.

## Spot checks against the page images

Three pages, every article compared with `09.pdf` at 75 dpi (25 September 2026).

| page | chosen because | index headwords | at the right entry | wrong entry | unlocated | labels |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 500 | an ordinary page | 12 | 12 | 0 | 0 | 12 right |
| 422 | the worst page (1 of 11 read) | 11 | 9 | 0 | 2 | 9 right |
| 823 | a failed reading (1 of 12) | 12 | 0 | 0 | 12 | — |

- **P. 500**: the run of တိဏသူလ… and တိဏဟာရ…, every entry and label right.
- **P. 422**: တာဝတိ˙သ… (above). Unlocated: တာဝတိံသဒေဝနဂရ and တာဝတိံသဒေဝလောကာဘိမုခ.
- **P. 823**: the page image is clean and all twelve entries are plain to read; the OCR is not.

No article on the three pages is placed at a wrong entry, and no label is wrong.
